lines.text: Shift's on the board, drinks are on the slate. Sit, you're blocking the door.
You're Sable's problem tonight, not mine. Hands on the bar.
You've got the look of somebody who's been shot at. Gate Nine or the Sink?
Long Shift's open every hour a tram runs. That's every hour.

barks.text: Dispatcher held me at the Rim for nine minutes. No reason given. There's never a reason.
Ration count's off again. Off by the same amount as last week.
Halo? Keep walking till the street stops. Long way on foot. Should've put a tram in.
Double shift, then a bar. Then the next double.
Market closes, we open. Nobody's ever seen both of us awake.
